beats.spoken: Friday, 10:20 a.m. Mia from the office wants to use Copilot: Summarise the quote for Example Ltd and compare it with similar quotes. She hesitates: is that safe?

mail.subject: Compare quote
lines: and compare it with similar ones.

beats.spoken: You check. Account: your work account. Training: Microsoft says prompts aren't used to train foundation models. Storage: encrypted and kept separate from other customers. All sorted. Just one thing is missing: Copilot also uses documents the person has access to.

fact.text: Copilot uses documents the person has access to.

beats.spoken: What comes first? A: Better not, the AI will learn from it. B: Take out the customer names, then go. C: First check who can see which folders. Remember your choice.

options.text: Better not, the AI learns from it
First check who sees which folders

beats.spoken: Let's play out B. Mia asks without names. Copilot searches your files for similar quotes. The answer also quotes a costing from the owner's folder. That folder has been shared with everyone for years.

The right answer is C. Microsoft advises setting permissions, for example in SharePoint, so only the right people have access. On A: Microsoft says prompts don't train foundation models. On B: Copilot still sees everything the person can see.
Tidy up sharing first, then ask Copilot. What would you have picked? Tell me in the comments.
